items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: from Panama we had Sig Carter; he was a light-skinned fellow. We had twelve pieces.

ctx.x: had--I can't think of his name--and on bass dark-skinned boy, from Panama we had Sig Carter; he was a light-skinned fellow. We had twelve pieces.
That was considered a pretty big band in those days.
